thread:
nina: Quick follow-up from last night's KV OOM cluster cascade. Opening this thread to track concrete remediations and owners.

omar: saw the same across eu-2 and us-east. Shard signal: tombstone backlog + free-span fragmentation. Heap snapshot: snap-2026-04-14-0230 uploaded.

liam: immediate mitigation idea: temporarily increase kv.soft_limit_shard by 18% and enable tombstone_fast_path on shards with delete-rate >150/s. I can run the canary.

maya: profiling note: GC sampling interval currently 10s, which delays tombstone sweep; propose sampling -> 2s for opt-in clusters during canary. Owner: maya for sampling patch.

sophie: i'll prepare a short runbook and healthcheck. Canary criteria: no OOMs, 95th latency within 20% baseline, CPU not above 78% for 5m. I own the runbook and dashboard panel.

omar: medium-term actions:
- defragmentation daemon for high-frag shards (owner: liam, PoC 2026-04-26)
- continuous allocation sampling (owner: maya, proto 2026-04-20)
- GC cadence experiment (owner: nina, plan 2026-04-18)
- surfacing "tombstone_age" metric + eviction misses (owner: sophie, dashboard by 2026-04-16)

incident-bot: Incident linked INC-2026-0414-KV-OM. Severity: S2. Reminders scheduled for owners 48h before due dates.

liam: note: defrag job must be rate-limited and avoid long pauses. I'll include a CPU throttle param.

maya: regression risk: faster GC increases IO spikes by ~3-5% in lab. Add CPU/IO budget to canary.

nina: assigning timelines (compact):
- canary deploy (liam + sophie): tonight within 6h
- GC cadence experiment infra (nina): 2026-04-18
- continuous sampling prototype (maya): 2026-04-20
- defrag PoC (liam): 2026-04-26
- dashboard metrics (sophie): 2026-04-16

sophie: PR opened: https://git.redwood/pr/kv/3844 with runbook attached.

omar: i'll add an alert rule to detect recurring pattern: trigger if >2 shards hit >1.5x residency growth in 24h. Owner: omar.

liam: starting canary now on canary pool, posting logs in 20m.

maya: will standby to analyze sampling traces.

nina: keeping this thread as the single action tracker. Please add blockers only. We'll reconvene after canary results. :white_check_mark:
